premises.text: Consumer-driven health is growing while at-home wellness lab testing stays underserved
premises.evidence_span: These forces have given rise to a $250 billion consumer-driven health industry

premises.text: Eight expandable at-home kits cover evidenced markers via mailed samples and a clear results dashboard
premises.evidence_span: We have eight test kits available that study key, well-evidenced lab markers

premises.text: Partner labs are CLIA-certified and tests match doctor-ordered accuracy under DTC rules in operating states
premises.evidence_span: all of our partner labs are fully CLIA-certified, proven reference laboratories that conduct third-party independent validation testing

premises.text: Virtual physicians, kit fulfillment, and HL7 normalization power the simple consumer flow
premises.evidence_span: we translate largely unstandardized HL7 information across multiple labs, markers, and tests into the dashboard and results

premises.text: Online kit prices from $79–$399 undercut typical out-of-pocket lab costs
premises.evidence_span: from $79 to $399. These costs are actually lower by test than out-of-pocket or not-covered costs per test, and often the same or lower than insurance

value.text: Transform consumer lab testing into an understandable at-home experience
value.evidence_span: transforming the consumer lab testing experience

causal_links.evidence_span: there had to be a better way
as accurate as a test your doctor would order

notes: Market-size figure kept only as industry context inside the gap premise; $250B is framing attached to the untouched-DTC claim. Vision of ubiquitous wellness tests not coded as premise (§4.1(4)).
